national_law.name: Law of 26 April 2024 establishing a framework for the cybersecurity of networks and information systems of general interest for public security

competent_authority.name: Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium
competent_authority.role: National cybersecurity authority and national CSIRT

framework.name: CyberFundamentals Framework (CyFun)
framework.description: Set of concrete measures to protect data, reduce risk of common cyber attacks, and increase cyber resilience
framework.note: All organisations in NIS2 supply chains advised to comply with CyFun Basic level minimum

notes: Belgium was among the first EU countries to transpose NIS2
CyberFundamentals (CyFun) framework is the primary compliance mechanism
CCB operates SafeOnWeb portal for entity guidance
Self-assessment of CyFun level or ISO 27001 compliance due by April 18, 2026
